 Home » Entertainment »  Television Bigg Boss 20: Seven Contestants Nominated For Week 7 Eviction
 Television DC Correspondent 19 Oct 2026 12:04 PM IST 19 Oct 2026 12:04 PM IST The contestants are back for the seventh week of nominations.
 x Salman Khan As Preferred
Source Bigg Boss 20 is hosted by actor Salman Khan, who showed the exit door to Aman Gandhi during the weekend episode. 
 The contestants are back for the seventh week of nominations.
 Are you wondering who is nominated for this week's elimination? Uditi Singh, Amrapali Dubey, Manish Goel, Arishfa Khan, Lovepreet Gill, Kushal Tanwar, and Mary Kom are up for eviction.
 It remains to be seen who will be the next contestant to leave the house after Aman Gandhi.
 Murmurs are doing the rounds that the show organizers are planning a few wildcard entries. If the makers are really planning them, we should wait and see who will be entering the show.
